messages.en:
{07 00 00}You a big{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}fish-chicken
or something? You gotta
see my new fish!
{07 07 00}This thing is so ripped,
even its fins have muscles,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sa oled mingi{01 00 00 05 00} {07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}kala-kana
või midagi? Sa pead
mu uut kala nägema!
{07 07 00}See asi on nii pumbatud,
et uimedelgi on lihased,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Keeping fish is cool, but
changing the water uses
lots of muscles, {07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}right?
{07 0d 00}Well, that's why they're the
perfect pets for me,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kalu pidada on äge, aga
vee vahetamine nõuab
kõvasti lihaseid, {07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}eks?
{07 0d 00}Noh, just seepärast on nad
mulle ideaalsed lemmikud,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Having fish tanks in your
place {01 00 00 05 00}helps keep it nice and
cool, y'know.
{07 0d 00}It's great when you're all
hot and sweaty after a
good workout, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Akvaariumid su kodus
{01 00 00 05 00}hoiavad seal toreda
jaheduse, tead küll.
{07 0d 00}See on super, kui oled
pärast head trenni
kuum ja higine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
